title: TrueLens
tagline: TrueLens: AI-powered multi-chain news verification system with Hedera consensus, vlayer & Pyth
description:
TrueLens is a comprehensive news verification ecosystem that combats misinformation through blockchain transparency and AI analysis. The platform integrates multiple cutting-edge technologies to provide real-time credibility scoring for news articles, financial reports, and social media content.
Key Features:
Multi-Chain Verification: Leverages Hedera Consensus Service for transparent logging, vlayer for cryptographic web proofs, and Pyth Network for real-time financial data validation
AI-Powered Analysis: Veritas AI agent performs intelligent content analysis, sentiment detection, and credibility scoring
Real-Time Dashboard: Comprehensive monitoring system showing service health across all integrated networks
NFT Credentials: Blockchain-based verification certificates for trusted news sources
Marketplace Integration: Platform for news verification services with tokenized incentives
The system addresses the critical problem of information authenticity in our digital age by providing verifiable, transparent, and decentralized fact-checking infrastructure that news organizations, researchers, and individuals can trust.
how_its_made:
TrueLens is built as a sophisticated multi-chain architecture combining several innovative technologies:
Frontend (Next.js 14 + TypeScript):
Modern React-based UI with TailwindCSS for responsive design
Real-time dashboards showing verification statistics and service health
Wallet integration for blockchain interactions
Modular component architecture with shared UI libraries
Blockchain Integration:
Hedera Consensus Service: Stores immutable logs of all AI agent decisions and verification processes, ensuring transparency and auditability
vlayer Web Proofs: Generates cryptographic proofs of web content authenticity, allowing verification of original sources
Pyth Network: Provides real-time price feeds for financial news validation and market data verification
Smart Contracts: Solidity contracts on multiple chains for verification logic and credential management
Backend Services (Node.js/Express):
Veritas AI Agent: OpenAI-powered analysis engine for content credibility scoring
Multi-chain orchestration: Coordinates between different blockchain networks
API endpoints: RESTful services for frontend integration and external access
Notable Technical Innovations:
Cross-chain verification pipeline: Seamlessly integrates three different blockchain technologies (Hedera, vlayer, Pyth) in a unified workflow
Real-time consensus logging: Every AI decision is logged to Hedera's consensus service for complete transparency
Cryptographic source proofs: vlayer generates zero-knowledge proofs of web content, making source verification tamper-proof
Financial data validation: Pyth price feeds validate financial claims in real-time against market data
Partner Technology Benefits:
Hedera: Provides fast, low-cost consensus with enterprise-grade security for audit trails
vlayer: Enables trustless web content verification without relying on centralized authorities
Pyth: Offers high-frequency, reliable financial data that's crucial for economic news verification
The architecture is designed for scalability and can process thousands of verification requests while maintaining decentralization and transparency principles.
